source.table: Table 5. Outlays of the U.S. Government, May 2026 and Other Periods
source.title: Grand-total capstone for Table 5 (Outlays), page 22. Full 9-column model. The three bottom-of-table grand aggregate rows: Total Outlays, Total On-Budget, Total Off-Budget. Two self-contained identity families, no re-anchoring of section totals (see plan's grand-capstone decision): (1) Total On-Budget + Total Off-Budget = Total Outlays per column; (2) the per-row net identity net + applicable = gross. 'Total Surplus (+) or Deficit (-)' is OUT OF SCOPE (it references Table 4 receipts). Family pattern: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md (section 'Grand capstone decision').
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Nine-column model: 3 periods x (Gross Outlays / Applicable Receipts / Outlays[net]). This unit captures only the three grand aggregate rows at the foot of Table 5 (page 22): Total Outlays, Total On-Budget, Total Off-Budget. It deliberately does NOT re-anchor the 30 section totals (that full table-wide cross-foot is a deferred optional '-grand-sum-*' tier -- see plan). The 'Total Surplus (+) or Deficit (-)' rows below are OUT OF SCOPE (they net Table 5 outlays against Table 4 receipts, which this corpus keeps in a separate family). Relations: On-Budget + Off-Budget = Total Outlays per column (verified net This-Month: 490,896 + 137,265 = 628,161), and the per-row net identity net + applicable = gross. Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.' All observed gaps are +/-1 (these grand totals aggregate hundreds of independently-rounded section figures); all values render-verified against page 22.
